title: thelypteris crassa
intro: Thelypteris crassa, commonly known as the large wood fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Central and South America, and is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Thelypteris crassa include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health, while its therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris crassa include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
